rule.candidate: PASS_CANDIDATE means the current production path and one or more named assertions directly cover every clause; it is not a PASS promotion.
rule.assertionGap: ASSERTION_GAP means implementation may exist, but the current executed assertions do not directly prove every clause.
rule.implementationGap: IMPLEMENTATION_GAP means a production behavior is absent or demonstrably incorrect.
rule.unresolved: No unresolved classification is permitted. A later promotion still requires a per-requirement receipt and direct clause rationale.
